topic: NBA SOTA ExtraTrees Dominance + Political Feature Pipeline Repair

sota_refs.title: Uncertainty-Aware ML for NBA Forecasting (MDPI Information 2026)
sota_refs.key_finding: LSTM+MC-dropout achieves best betting calibration. Top-3 features: home_next (next game at home), team_elo_5_y (5-year ELO window), team_elo. Logistic regression Brier=0.199 (tabular SOTA). XGBoost Brier=0.202.
sota_refs.actionable: home_next (is next game at home?) is top-3 predictor — check if our feature engine includes it

sota_refs.title: Stacked Ensemble NBA Prediction (Nature Scientific Reports 2025)
sota_refs.key_finding: Stacked ensemble achieves CNN Brier=0.221. Logistic regression attains best Brier=0.199 among single models. XGBoost best AUC=0.754 but worse probability calibration.
sota_refs.actionable: LR post-calibration head on top of ExtraTrees/CatBoost — LR's calibration strength on tree model's features

sota_refs.title: NBA prediction with ML (Towards Data Science)
sota_refs.key_finding: Best single model accuracy=0.87 achieved by LR, ElasticNet, SVM, DNN (Dec 2025). Home_next and ELO features dominate importance.

proposals.title: Add home_next temporal feature to features/engine.py
proposals.problem: MDPI 2026 ranks home_next as #1 predictor. Teams conserve effort knowing an upcoming home game reduces travel fatigue pressure.
proposals.implementation: In features/engine.py: for each game, look up next scheduled game in season schedule. home_next=1 if team plays at home in their next game, 0 otherwise. away_next_after_away=1 as a back-to-back fatigue compounding flag. Add 2 features to Cat3 TEMPORAL block.
proposals.expected_impact: 0.001-0.003 Brier improvement. Top-3 SOTA feature currently missing.
proposals.cpu_cost: low — O(n) schedule lookup, precomputed at feature extraction time

proposals.title: Logistic regression Platt scaling post-calibration
proposals.problem: LR achieves Brier=0.199 (SOTA) on same data as ExtraTrees. Our ExtraTrees gets good ranking but tails may be miscalibrated. Venn-Abers works but requires full holdout.
proposals.implementation: After ExtraTrees fit, train a 2-param sigmoid (Platt scaling) on out-of-fold predictions. sklearn CalibratedClassifierCV(method='sigmoid') wrapping ExtraTrees. Test as alternative to venn_abers in islands.
proposals.expected_impact: 0.001-0.003 Brier, especially for high-confidence games where miscalibration is costly

proposals.title: Fix political feature pipeline: 272 → 3200 candidates
proposals.problem: Political engine v3.22 has 44 categories / ~3200 features on paper but islands see only 272. Cats 9-44 fail silently because snapshot data files and import modules are not present in HF space.
proposals.root_cause: (a) fetch_political_data imports fail or return sparse data; (b) cat39-43 standalone modules not deployed to HF space; (c) cat44 YouTube FinBERT has no sentiment.parquet on HF.
proposals.implementation: Step 1: Audit what data is actually available in the HF space event dicts (check saved evolution results). Step 2: For cats 23-26 (FEC velocity, congressional trades, EO timeline, tariff regime) — these only need event metadata (date, ticker, signal_type) — add fallback default signals when upstream data is missing. Step 3: Deploy cat39-43 snapshot files to hf-space/ in repo.
proposals.expected_impact: 10x more feature candidates for GA to select from. Estimated 0.005-0.01 Brier improvement when combined with the larger search space.

proposals.title: ExtraTrees bias injection on diversify/recover events
proposals.observation: S17 (ET 200-feat 0.22084), S18 (ET 51-feat 0.22248), S22 historical record (venn_abers on ET base, 0.22073). Extra Trees consistently outperforms CatBoost/LightGBM/XGBoost on this dataset.
proposals.implementation: When diversify is triggered on S13 (which uses xgboost), inject ET seed: POST /api/config with suggested model override to extra_trees with calibration=venn_abers. Low-effort: just mutate toward ET config space.
proposals.expected_impact: Faster convergence to ET optimum on S13 recovery. Potentially 0.22523→0.22250 in next 5 cycles.
